title: Notification
description: pixelbar/<target>/notify/<key>. A card plus delivery, or a screen to show while it lasts. Retained for ongoing conditions (with expires), not retained for one-offs. An empty retained payload clears it.

box.description: Show it in this box. A display without a box by this name skips it, unless fallback is true.

fallback.description: With box: on a display without that box, fall back to the tier rules. false by default.

rank.description: Order inside a tier, higher first.

takeover.description: Take the whole strip for this long, in seconds; set it to a tune's length to keep the animation up while it plays. 0 never, until_cleared until it's cleared.

slot.description: Borrow a box for this long. 0 goes straight to the tray.

rotate.description: Join the box's rotation while active.

tray.description: How long its icon stays in the tray.

edge.description: Draw the alert bar along the bottom while active.

repeat.description: Come back this often while active.

renotify.description: On an update, show it again instead of changing the words quietly.

screens.description: The screens it may show on. Every screen that isn't quiet by default; critical ignores this.

sound.description: What the buzzer plays when it arrives: a built-in pattern or saved tune by name, or { rtttl }, { steps } or { pattern, repeat }. Nothing on a quiet screen.

expires.description: Drop it at this time even if nothing clears it. Every retained notification should set this.

screen.description: Show this screen while the notification lasts, unless the state topic picks one; the newest notification with a screen wins. Its boxes keep reading live data, so a ticker screen stays current. A display without a screen by this name ignores it.
